conditionalLaneEntry.require: Finish the original CLI prepare job and its fixed result reads under the existing GO. Persist actual authority succeeded/exit0/full/durable/terminal-confirmed, complete passed final stdout and passed whole result, original owned cleanup, and a complete owner release proving every original observer closed, zero pending native futures/calls and zero business processes. If any current scope failure/UNKNOWN/missing ACK remains, do not enter H2. Send that exact release to root before H2 admission; no extra confirmation is needed once this condition is proven.
conditionalLaneEntry.rootIndependentCLIResultReview: Root will independently review the completed CLI result; this conditional scope grants H2 prepare only and does not qualify CLI live.
conditionalLaneEntry.otherLane: A retains original AuthBus scope; max2 Runtime lanes; root0.

full_GO.startRule: Persist the exact request and external intent before a single process_start. Preserve original November5 key across UTC midnight. Store original SDK before parsing; exact native digest/fingerprint; original returned job only; no replay or key replacement.

conditionalResultRead.enabledOnlyAfter: Original authoritative succeeded/exit0/full/durable/terminal-publication-confirmed with no timeout/cancel/retry; complete original stdout exactly identifies the fixed result path and actual result_sha256, status=passed, runtime_started=false, all_owned_stopped=true; complete stderr empty.
conditionalResultRead.metadataRequirements: Original metadata handler closed and payload complete; regular non-symlink single-link file, uid1000/gid1000/0600/linux, size1..65536, whole-file SHA from final stdout; actual immutable version retained losslessly.
conditionalResultRead.allowedTransformation: Only null limit and expected_version become exact original metadata size and immutable version; persist the exact derived request and intent first.
conditionalResultRead.ifOverCap: Stop before body admission and report actual metadata. This read admission cap is independent of the original live reader's unchanged 4MiB cap; do not infer a producer size bound.
conditionalResultRead.extraContentChecks: Verify inputs and original child_provenance/child_exec_visibility/owned_cleanup; compare nanosecond deadlines losslessly; completed_after_cleanup_monotonic_ns < deadline_monotonic_ns.

full_GO.failureRule: Any native failure/refusal/missing ACK/UNKNOWN stops new admissions; close only already returned original observers. Immutable archival failure may recover identical received public bytes via Git content tree, never native replay.

local_helper_correction.scope: Only local fsync exec session yield handling; original remote requests, keys, source, budgets and observers unchanged.
local_helper_correction.root_instruction: Persist returned original local session; poll same session until natural terminal; no re-exec.
